request.deadline: instant upon enactment; no calendar deadline stated in document
deliverables: Instant on-chain distribution to the intended recipient upon governance action enactment
request.recipient: the Ikigai Info governance action submitter; specific address or identity not stated in document
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to reimburse the Ikigai Info governance action deposit and claimed lost staking rewards.

claims.claim: An Info governance action titled Cardanoの生きがい - Ikigai - was submitted in September 2024 shortly after the Chang hard fork.
The Ikigai action was symbolic and asked the community whether they agreed with a statement thanking contributors and expressing hope for Cardano's future.
A Cardano node bug permitted an unregistered stake key to be used in the governance action, preventing the submitter from recovering the 100,000 ADA deposit.
The community expressed significant sentiment that the Ikigai submitter should be reimbursed and should not lose 100,000 ADA for being an early governance pioneer.
The Cardano in Oceania initiative included this reimbursement in its budget Info governance action, but that governance action was not approved.
The requested 103,000 ADA consists of the original 100,000 ADA deposit plus 3,000 ADA for lost staking rewards calculated at 2% per annum.
The recipient has not previously received funds from the treasury.
The requested amount does not exceed the current Net Change Limit.
The distribution can be audited on-chain because funds will be made directly available to the intended recipient.
No administrator custody, audit budget, oversight budget, costs, expenses, or refund circumstances are required for this withdrawal.

summary: The proposal requests 103,000 ADA from the treasury to reimburse a 100,000 ADA governance action deposit and 3,000 ADA in claimed lost staking rewards, asserting the loss resulted from a Cardano node bug and that payment would occur directly on-chain to the intended recipient.
